$comment: Generic technical-sandbox move set. ROADMAP Phase 1A requires basic punches, guard and evasion BEFORE character-specific abilities, and Rule 22 requires counterplay from the first punch. EVERY FRAME AND COST VALUE BELOW IS A TUNING HYPOTHESIS (Rule 18) - they exist so the sandbox has a complete, validatable starting table, not because they are balanced.
frame_basis: 60 ticks per second, fixed-tick authoritative simulation

moves.hit_reaction: short head snap, minor balance disruption
moves.counter_vulnerability: low; short recovery leaves only a narrow counter window
moves.positional_consequence: holds range, does not advance position

moves.hit_reaction: head displacement, balance loss on clean contact
moves.counter_vulnerability: moderate; rear-hand commitment opens the lead side
moves.positional_consequence: weight transfers forward, briefly reduces lateral mobility

moves.hit_reaction: lateral head rotation, elevated jaw exposure
moves.counter_vulnerability: high against a fighter who steps inside the arc
moves.positional_consequence: opens the lead side during the arc

moves.counter_vulnerability: high; longest arc in the generic set
high; drops the lead shoulder line
moves.positional_consequence: requires closed distance, cannot be thrown at range

moves.hit_reaction: severe upward displacement on clean contact
downward-angled head displacement, heavy balance loss on clean contact
moves.counter_vulnerability: highest in the generic set; the looping path telegraphs and the head travels forward with it
moves.positional_consequence: deepest forward weight commitment, slowest reset, cedes the centre if it misses

moves.counter_vulnerability: high; lowers the head into counter range
moves.positional_consequence: requires closing, taxes the target's later rounds

moves.hit_reaction: absorbs to the arms; guard integrity and arm condition degrade
moves.counter_vulnerability: low directly; passive holding is punished by varied placement and body work
moves.positional_consequence: static; cedes ring position under pressure

moves.hit_reaction: absorbs to the arms and elbows
moves.counter_vulnerability: low directly; leaves the head available

moves.hit_reaction: none when successful; attacker pays dodged commitment cost
moves.counter_vulnerability: high if mistimed against a feint
moves.positional_consequence: creates a counter angle without ceding range

moves.counter_vulnerability: high against uppercuts and body work
moves.positional_consequence: lowers level, sets up inside counters

moves.counter_vulnerability: moderate; entering is when counters land
moves.positional_consequence: closes distance; stride compresses inside threatening range per the Elastic Footwork model
resets range; repeated use without offense reads as empty avoidance
changes angle; primary answer to ring cutting
escapes corners and creates angles; requires visible weight transfer
halts exchange; repeated use is referee-dependent and counts toward clinch abuse recognition
